title: Engineering Assistant – Electrical, Instrumentation & Automation Engineering (Remote Contractor - Long Term)
description:
Equinox Automation is a specialist engineering consultancy based in New Zealand. We support industrial and energy clients with safety-critical engineering, including fire and gas mapping, functional safety, machine safety, instrumentation, control systems, and high-hazard facility work.



This is a serious professional services business. We are looking for a strong Engineering Assistant who wants ownership, responsibility, and long-term growth.



This is not a basic task-taker role.



We are looking for someone who can assist our engineers in delivering safety-critical projects — capturing and organising technical data, maintaining accurate registers and records, and following through on drawing reviews and documentation so nothing falls through the cracks. You'll also be using 3D model software, software-based drawing tools, and other specialist engineering software packages. 



The right person will bring structure and consistency to project documentation and make life easier for the engineers they support.



The Core Role



Responsibilities include assisting with:



• Engineering deliverables across project work, including data capture, drawing markups, and technical reports

• Registers, tables, action lists, review comments, and project records

• Drawing reviews, technical markups, and as-building markups

• Fire & Gas Mapping, Functional Safety, and Machine Safety workflows — data extraction, model inputs, registers, datasheets, and report preparation support

• Instrumentation, Control and Electrical design workflows — instrument lists, I/O lists, cable schedules, equipment schedules, and commissioning documents

• Microsoft Office, Bluebeam, AutoCAD/DWG, and 3D model software, including model preparation and adjustments

• Internal SOPs, templates, checklists, and workflow improvements



What We're Looking For



• Engineering degree, or relevant professional experience, in electrical, instrumentation and control, electronics, mechatronics, or industrial engineering, or with relevant engineering design and documentation experience 

• Strong attention to detail and clear, accurate technical English

• Able to read and work with engineering drawings and technical documents

• Strong Microsoft Office 365 skills; Bluebeam, AutoCAD/DWG, or similar software an advantage

• Able to work independently in a remote role, with good file management and document control habits

• Reliable, organised, and delivery focused, with a continuous improvement mindset

• Comfortable handling confidential business and client information

• Reliable high-speed internet, a secure remote setup, dual monitors, and ability to configure approved VPN access for New Zealand



Engagement Details



• Remote contractor role, 40 hours per week / 8 hours per day, Monday to Friday

• Core hours 1:00pm–5:00pm NZST, with occasional availability 8:00am–1:00pm NZST for meetings and reviews

• Other hours may be agreed upon based on performance and reliability after the trial period.

• Clear communication required through Teams,
, and project systems

• Contractor rate negotiable based on skill and experience; contractor responsible for own taxes, equipment, and work setup

• Initial basis - one-month trial. Long-term opportunity for the right person.



How to Apply



Please send:

1. Your CV

2. A short cover letter explaining your relevant experience

3. A custom 60-second video explaining why we should hire you for this role

4. Answers to the screening questions below



Generic or reused videos won't be accepted — the video must be specific to this role. Applications missing the video or screening answers will not be reviewed.



To show you read this full advert, include the phrase “detail-driven engineer” at the start of your application.



Applications close on 8th June, 5pm NZST. May close time earlier, depending on application demand and capability.



Screening Questions

1. Tell me briefly about yourself and your current work situation.

2. Tell me about your engineering background — your degree, specialisation, or relevant technical experience.

3. Have you worked on instrumentation, control, electrical, functional safety, fire and gas, or machine safety projects before? If yes, what did you do?

4. How comfortable are you reading and marking up engineering drawings (P&IDs, layouts, schematics)?

5. What software tools have you used? Include Microsoft 365, Bluebeam, AutoCAD/DWG tools, 3D model software, and any specialist engineering software.

6. Tell me about a time your attention to detail caught an error before it became a problem.

7. What is your expected contractor hourly rate in PHP?

Your job is to guide new clients through their first 48 hours inside the program. You remove confusion, fix tech issues, assign the right 1:1 Coach, and make sure clients are fully set up before strategy begins.



This is not a passive support role. You are responsible for structure, clarity, activation speed, and client confidence.



This is a client-facing role. You must be clear, confident, calm, and reliable.



Most of our clients are 45+ and not tech-savvy. Patience and strong communication are required.



BENEFITS



- $900/month guaranteed base

- Performance bonuses based on CSAT (client rating) and CSQ (coach rating)

- OTE: $1,050–$1,400/month

- Bonus tiers from $30–$100 per category (minimum 20 surveys / 20 handoffs per month)

- Fully remote, long-term role

- Clear scorecard and monthly reviews

- Career growth path (Senior TOM, Lead TOM, CSM)

- 4,000+ clients served since 2019



SCHEDULE



- 7.5 hours per day (Monday to Friday)

- No fixed shift required. You may work a straight or split shift.

- You must attend tea
etings (usually 3pm CET)

- Work 7.5 total hours per day within the 8 AM ET to 2 AM ET coverage window, not across the entire window

- Confirm your preferred working hours during hiring

- Maintain a schedule that is sustainable long term



Consistently low energy or repeated mistakes caused by poor schedule management will be treated as performance issues.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run structured Activation Calls

- Fully activate every client within 48 hours. Activation means the client has access to Kajabi, Slack, the Client Master Sheet, AI tools (AVA & VERA), understands where everything is, has a Coach assigned, and has their Kickoff Call booked.

- Book Kickoff Call same day or next day

- Assign the correct 1:1 Coach based on phase, fluency, timezone, and availability

- Build authority for the assigned Coach so the client feels confident before strategy begins

- Ensure basic access or setup issues do not reach Coaches

- Update CRM immediately after each call

- Send clear handoff notes to Coaches

- Upload all call recordings

- Reply in #tech-support within 24 hours (weekdays)

- Onboard 20–25 clients per week. Activation Calls are structured and typically 30–45 minutes.

Some weeks are high-volume during promotions. Quality and clarity must remain strong under pressure.

- Keep your calendar accurate and available

- Proactively manage your calendar capacity and flag issues early

- Avoid repeated client-facing process errors



Main goal: Zero confusion for the client. No surprises for the Coach.



CORE STANDARDS



- 100% activation within 48 hours

description:

CoreRecovery (

We're growing our product range and need someone reliable to help upload new products to our Shopify store accurately and consistently.



What the Job Is:

This is a focused, task-based role. You'll be uploading new products to our Shopify store, one product at a time, paid per completed upload.



Before each product, we provide you with everything you need:

- A spreadsheet with all the product details (title, price, variants, specs, images, etc.)

- An HTML template for the product description (already built and formatted to our brand style)

- Keyword research to incorporate into the description and SEO fields





Your job is to take that information and build the product page in Shopify correctly, accurately, and to a consistent standard every time.



What a Completed Upload Looks Like:

A product is complete when all of the following are done:



Product title, vendor, product type, and tags entered correctly

Price and variants set up (if applicable)

Product description built using the provided HTML template and keywords

Images uploaded in the correct order

SEO title and meta description filled in using the provided keywords

Product added to the correct collection(s)

Product reviewed against the provided checklist before marking as done





What We're Looking For

Solid experience with Shopify Admin — you know how to navigate the product editor, upload images, use the HTML/code view for descriptions, and set up variants

High attention to detail — you follow the template and checklist exactly, every time

Comfortable working with HTML (basic level — copy, paste, make small adjustments as needed)

Good English reading comprehension — you'll be working from written briefs and spreadsheets

Reliable and communicative — if something's unclear, you ask before guessing

Previous experience with e-commerce product listings is a strong plus



How This Works Day to Day

We send you the product brief (spreadsheet + HTML template + keywords)

You build the product page in Shopify

You submit it for review once complete

Once approved, you're paid per product



There's no fixed schedule. Work when it suits you, as long as turnaround per product is within 24-48 hours of receiving the brief.



How to Apply



Please include in your application:

Your experience with Shopify — specifically with product listings and the HTML/code editor

Any e-commerce stores you've worked on (a URL if it's public)

Your expected rate per product uploaded



One last thing — to confirm you've read this post properly, please start your application with the words "Ready to upload". Applications that don't include this will not be reviewed.

title: Wedding Photo Editor
description:
Hello, we are looking for editors to have a recurring working relationship with. Our company provides wedding photography services. We collect RAW files from photographers, cull them ourselves, and apply presets. We work within Aftershoot, Lightroom, and Photoshop. We would like to provide pre-culled Lightroom Catalogs to editors who will then use their professional judgement to review and edit the catalog.



We are looking for someone to do the detailed edits (removing blemishes, removing flyaway hairs, removing simple objects from backgrounds, adjust lighting if the preset left the photos too over/under exposed). We tell our clients that we do realistic edits (so no background changes and no body modification). The ideal editor will use their best judgement when evaluating a photo.



We understand that not every photo in a catalog will require detail editing, but we budget editing based on the number of photos in a catalog. We also pay a per-photo rate based on quantity of photos within a catalog. The quantity of photos in a catalog ranges from 210 to 1000 per wedding. If this is something you have an interest in, we would love to know that you read this whole project description by telling us your ideal travel destination. Thank you!

About Ensign Partners

Ensign Partners brings simplicity to complexity by integrating legal, financial, tax, insurance, and advisory expertise under one roof. Our clients receive one coordinated plan, one trusted team, and a clear path forward.

We are a values-driven firm built on professionalism, trust, and long-term relationships. Every role at Ensign matters. We believe exceptional client experiences are created through consistency, accuracy, and people who take pride in doing things the right way.

I’m a minister, real estate broker, and author based in Tennessee. I show up in many different spaces — from pulpits to closing tables to Sunday brunch — and I want my wardrobe to reflect confidence, modesty, purpose, and grace. My style is a blend of sophistication and professionalism, with a touch of Afrocentric flair.

Create polished and appropriate outfits for specific events like:



Sunday services

Real estate closings and networking

Speaking engagements (in person and virtual)

Brunch or lunch with friends

Travel and formal events

Build lookbooks and mood boards in the app so I can easily find what to wear

Tag each item and outfit with helpful details like occasion, season, and location

Suggest styling adjustments, accessory pairings, or layering options

Someone with experience in styling, wardrobe curation, or fashion coordination

A person who understands how to work with modest, professional, ministry-appropriate clothing

Comfortable using iOS and willing to work inside the Indyx app (training provided if needed)

Organized and good at communicating clearly and kindly

Someone who enjoys helping others look and feel their best

This is a short-term project paid by the hour

title: Bookkeeper to Financial Analyst (Full-Time, Long-Term, US Company)
description:
## About OODA



We are an AI-native short-term rental management company. We run over 100 properties with a small team and heavy automation, and we are deliberately the opposite of the legacy property managers our owners left behind.



Most management companies treat the books as a back-office afterthought. We do not. Every owner gets a transparent monthly statement that ties every dollar to a specific property and a specific reservation. The person who owns that accuracy is one of the most trusted people in the company, and right now we are hiring that person.



## About the Role



This role starts as our bookkeeper and is built to grow into our financial analyst.



In the first phase, you own the daily books: categorizing hundreds of bank transactions a month, matching receipts and payouts to the correct property, reconciling reservation income, and producing clean owner invoices on time. Our financial system runs on ClickUp and Supabase with heavy automation, not a single off-the-shelf tool, so you will learn our way of doing things.



As you master the books, the role grows. You move into financial analysis: contribution margin by property, profit-and-loss accuracy, cash-flow reconciliation, and the financial KPIs that tell us which properties and which decisions actually make money. The path is Bookkeeper, then Financial Analyst, then Controller.



We are not hiring someone to only keep records. We are hiring someone who wants to understand the money and eventually help us run it.



## Who We're Looking For



**You have real bookkeeping experience.**

- You have reconciled accounts, categorized transactions, and matched receipts and payments before. Property management or hospitality experience is a plus, not a requirement.



**You are accurate at volume.**

- We process hundreds of transactions a month. You hold a 99%+ categorization standard, and you do not let things slip when the volume is high.



**You are fluent with systems, and you like that we use AI.**

- We run on ClickUp, Supabase, and internal AI agents, and we use Claude and automation aggressively. You learn new tools quickly and lean into that instead of resisting it.



**You are an analyst in waiting.**

- You are not satisfied with only recording numbers, you want to understand them. You know (or want to learn) what contribution margin is, what drives a property's profit, and why a number moved. You ask what a number means, not just where it goes.



**You own your work and communicate clearly.**

- Your written English is clear. You flag problems early instead of hiding them. You suggest process improvements because you would rather fix the system than repeat the same manual task.



## What "Great" Looks Like



**First 30 days:** You have learned our ClickUp and Supabase financial system, you understand our property portfolio, and you reconcile and categorize transactions independently to our time standard.



**First 90 days:** You consistently hit our reconciliation-timeliness and accuracy KPIs, owner statements go out on time, and you have surfaced at least three process improvements.



**First 180 days:** You own the monthly close with minimal review, and you begin producing contribution-margin and profit-and-loss views per property.



**First 365 days:** You function as our financial analyst. You own the financial KPI picture, you can tell us the contribution margin of any property, and you help Christian make pricing and cost decisions from the numbers. You are on the path to Controller.



## Compensation & Growth



- **This is a base-plus-KPI role, and we want you to understand that up front.** Your pay is tied to your performance, not just to being present.

- **Base pay: $6 to $10 per hour**, set by your qualifications and experience, with room to move up the range as you build tenure and prove results.

- **KPI performance bonus: 30% of your base**, earned by hitting your accounting KPIs. The KPIs are concrete and you will always know them: reconciliation timeliness, categorization accuracy, on-time owner statements, and, as you grow, the quality and timeliness of your financial analysis. The better you perform against them, the more you earn.

- **Growth is structured, not vague.** Bookkeeper, then Financial Analyst, then Controller. Your base moves up the range with experience and tenure, and your bonus rewards performance.

- You report directly to the founder.



## Schedule & Commitment



- **Full-time, 9:00am to 5:00pm, Monday to Friday, Philippines time.**

- This is your one job. We expect your full attention during these hours. We do not accept candidates who are running other jobs, freelance clients, or side work during the workday. If you are looking for a part-time role to stack alongside two others, this is not the one.

- We are remote and we trust you to work your hours, and that trust depends on you being present and focused during them.



## The Hard Parts (we are being honest)



- High transaction volume that demands real attention to detail.

- Firm turnaround standards. The books close on a schedule, not when it is convenient.

- A custom system you have to learn. We will train you, but you have to want to learn it.

- We measure performance. You are rewarded for results, not for logging hours.



## How to Apply



To apply, reply with this exact sentence:



**"I am looking for a full time job and understand that this is a 9-5 where I will not be able to have other clients."**

title: Senior Loan Processor
description:
About DreamPoint Capital

DreamPoint Capital is a private real estate lending brokerage specializing in DSCR (debt service coverage ratio) loans, residential transition loans (RTL/fix-and-flip), bridge financing, and commercial loan placements for real estate investors across the United States. We work with a deep network of institutional and private capital lenders to match borrowers with the right loan program and close transactions quickly.

We're a lean, technology-forward team. Our reps use proprietary AI-powered scenario matching, an AI receptionist, and modern loan workflow tooling — we expect our processors to be comfortable in that environment and contribute to making it better.



The Role

We're hiring an experienced loan processor to own files from submission through funding. You'll be the operational backbone between our reps, borrowers, and lenders — collecting conditions, structuring deals correctly the first time, and pushing files to close on tight investor timelines.

This is not an entry-level role. We need someone who can read a tri-merge, spot a DSCR shortfall, anticipate what a lender will ask for before they ask, and run multiple files in parallel without dropping balls.

What you'll do



Manage a pipeline of 15–25+ active DSCR, RTL, and bridge loan files concurrently from intake through funding

Review borrower intake packages for completeness — entity docs, credit, liquidity, experience, schedule of real estate owned, lease agreements, rent rolls, purchase contracts, rehab budgets, insurance binders

Order and review third-party reports: appraisals, BPOs, title commitments, flood certs, payoff statements, HOA estoppels

Calculate and verify DSCR, LTV, LTC, ARV, and debt yield against each lender's specific guideline matrix

Coordinate with title companies, attorneys, insurance agents, and lender underwriters to clear conditions

Prep clean submission packages and respond to lender conditions with precision and speed

Track every file in our loan management system; keep status notes current so reps and borrowers always know where things stand

Review closing disclosures and settlement statements for accuracy before close

Flag deal-killers early — title issues, appraisal gaps, entity structure problems, seasoning issues, recognition agreement requirements on co-op collateral

Contribute to process improvement — if a workflow is broken, you tell us and help fix it



What you need



5+ years of loan processing experience, with at least 2 years in non-QM, DSCR, fix-and-flip, bridge, or commercial real estate lending (this is non-negotiable — conventional/agency-only experience is not a fit)

Working knowledge of US private lending guidelines from at least a few of: Kiavi, Lima One, RCN, Roc Capital, Velocity, Visio, Constructive, LendingOne, Builders Capital, or similar

Comfort with entity-titled loans (LLC, LP, corporation), personal guarantees, and the documentation that comes with them

Sharp Excel skills — you can build a quick DSCR calc, reconcile a settlement statement, and audit a rent roll without complaint

Excellent written English — you will be in direct
 and Slack contact with US-based lenders, attorneys, and borrowers

Strong reading comprehension for legal and financial documents — title commitments, operating agreements, leases, purchase contracts

Self-directed work style; you don't need someone standing over you to hit deadlines

Reliable home office: stable high-speed internet, quiet environment, backup power, modern computer

Available for at least 4 hours of overlap with US Eastern time daily



Nice to have



Experience with co-op collateral, ground leases, or other complex collateral structures

Familiarity with TRID, RESPA, and basic compliance frameworks (even though most of our products are business-purpose and exempt)

Prior experience at a US-based lender, broker, or BPO supporting US lending operations

Comfort with modern tools: Slack, Notion, Google Workspace, AI tools (ChatGPT/Claude), and willingness to learn our internal apps

Exposure to title work, escrow coordination, or insurance review



What we offer



Competitive USD-denominated salary commensurate with experience (target range disclosed in first interview)

Performance bonuses tied to closed loan volume and file cycle time

Paid time off and Philippine holidays observed

Equipment stipend

Direct access to founder and senior team — your work has visible impact on the business

Growth path into senior operations, team lead, or underwriting roles as we scale



How to apply

Send a resume and a brief cover note describing the most complex loan file you've ever processed — what made it hard, and how you got it closed — to 
]. Please include "Senior Loan Processor — [Your Name]" in the subject line.

Candidates who pass initial screen will complete a paid case study using a real (anonymized) DSCR scenario before any final interviews.

We teach tens of thousands of creators and entrepreneurs how to make professional VFX content using their phones. Our content reaches millions. We need someone who can bring those effects to life for our marketing, ads, and social media accounts.

2. Visual effects content for our social media pages

3. Tutorial edits that teach our audience how to recreate effects

You'll complete four VFX hooks and one tutorial edit. It's not a full workweek. It's a structured evaluation with a clear scope and a clear finish line. Trial compensation is flexible based on experience. The $200 is a starting point, not a ceiling.



Here's the twist: before you start, you'll submit time estimates for each deliverable. We'll compare those to your actual time. This is not a trap. It's how we find people who know themselves, communicate clearly, and can work efficiently under real conditions.



If you fall behind, we want to know before the deadline. Not after.



---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



COMPENSATION



If your work scales, you earn more.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

- People who need step-by-step instructions for every task

- People who obsess over perfection at the expense of speed

- People looking for short-term freelance gigs

- People who go quiet when they hit a problem instead of communicating



---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

A short video intro telling us who you are, what experience you have, and why this role excites you (60 to 90 seconds)

A link to your portfolio or best past VFX work

- Manage inventory movements between suppliers, warehouses and customers.

- Ensure products are delivered efficiently while maintaining service levels.

- Coordinate customer purchase orders, order fulfilment and delivery schedules.

- Collaborate across the business to deliver operational excellence.

You're an organised, commercially minded operations professional who enjoys solving problems and building efficient processes. You're equally comfortable managing supplier relationships, analysing inventory and working with major retail customers.

- 3+ years' experience in operations, supply chain, production or wholesale management.

- Experience working with offshore manufacturers, preferably in China.

- Strong understanding of international logistics and supply chain operations.

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

- Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

- A proactive, solutions-focused mindset.

- Excellent project management and organisational skills.

- Confidence managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

- A collaborative approach and willingness to roll up your sleeves.

- A passion for building scalable operational processes.

- Significant ownership and autonomy within your role.

- The chance to make a visible impact on the business and influence how operations evolve.

- A collaborative, supportive and entrepreneurial team environment.

title: Website Build Specialist (GoHighLevel)
description:

You won't be writing website copy. You won't be designing websites. You won't be speaking to clients. Instead, you'll take our AI-generated website content and use our proven GoHighLevel system to build complete, production-ready websites. Everything is already created for you.

Your role is to use the software, generate the required pages, and accurately transfer every piece of content into the corresponding page within GoHighLevel, ensuring everything is formatted correctly and matches our quality standards.



--- 



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR: 



This role is perfect for someone who:

- Has GoHighLevel experience (required)

- Has excellent written English

- Has exceptional attention to detail

- Can work independently

- Enjoys repetitive, structured work

- Can consistently meet deadlines

--- 



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:



When I review a website I shouldn't find:

? Spelling mistakes

? Incorrect formatting

? Missing sections

? Placeholder content

? Broken links

Instead, I want to open the website and think:

"Perfect. Ready for images."



--- 



COMPENSATION: 



We pay per completed website build.



Current pricing:

Up to 40 pages - $55 USD

Examples:

40 pages = $55

50 pages = $60

60 pages = $65

80 pages = $75

100 pages = $85

200 pages = $135



The faster you build websites while maintaining quality, the more you can earn! For example, If we have 20 websites one month averaging 100 pages each you can earn $1700 that month!



--- 



BONUSES:



???? Speed Bonus

Complete a website within 48 hours of it being assigned while maintaining our quality standards and receive a 25% bonus for that project.

Our goal is to reach £10,000/month recurring revenue before December 30th.

If we hit that milestone, everyone who played a significant role in getting us there will receive a $1,000 USD performance bonus.

If we hit the target early, the bonus gets paid early.



--- 



WHY JOIN NOW?

You're joining right at the beginning. The systems are already built. Clients are already signing. Demand is growing every week.



As the business grows, there will be opportunities to earn more, take on additional responsibility and become a key member of the team.

This isn't just another freelance gig. We're building something long-term.

title: Website Image & Asset Specialist (GoHighLevel)
description:
ABOUT US:

Now we're looking for another Website Build Specialist to help us scale.

THIS ISN'T A GRAPHIC DESIGN ROLE

You won't be designing websites. You won't be creating graphics. You won't be speaking with clients.



Instead, you'll take websites that already have image placeholders and the completed copy and make them look premium by sourcing and preparing the perfect images. You'll play a huge part in the final quality of every project.



---

- Completing visual quality checks

- Following our SOPs and Loom training



--- 



What We're Looking For



This role is perfect for someone who:

- Has GoHighLevel experience

- Has an excellent eye for detail

- Naturally notices when something doesn't look right

- Enjoys creating polished, professional websites

- Can source high-quality imagery quickly

- Understands image optimisation

- Takes pride in producing premium work

- Works efficiently without sacrificing quality



We'll teach you our exact process.



--- 



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

When I review a website I shouldn't find:

? Generic stock photos

? Low-quality images

? Stretched or distorted images

? Images that don't match the content

? Poor visual consistency

Instead, I want to immediately think:

"That looks fantastic."



--- 



COMPENSATION



We pay per completed website build.



Current pricing:

Up to 40 pages - $55 USD

Every additional 10 pages - +$5 USD

Examples:

40 pages = $55

50 pages = $60

60 pages = $65

80 pages = $75

100 pages = $85

200 pages = $135



The faster you build websites while maintaining quality, the more you can earn! For example, If we have 20 websites one month averaging 100 pages each you can earn $1700 that month!



--- 



PERFORMANCE BONUSES



???? Speed Bonus



Complete a website within 48 hours of it being assigned while maintaining our quality standards and receive a 25% bonus for that project.



Quality always comes first. If significant revisions are required, the bonus won't apply.



???? Growth Bonus



Our goal is to reach £10,000/month recurring revenue before December 30th.



If we hit that milestone, everyone who played a significant role in getting us there will receive a $1,000 USD performance bonus.



If we hit the target early, the bonus gets paid early.



--- 



WHY JOIN NOW?

You're joining right at the beginning. The systems are already built. Clients are already signing. Demand is growing every week.



As the business grows, there will be opportunities to earn more, take on additional responsibility and become a key member of the team.

This isn't just another freelance gig. We're building something long-term.



--- 



HOW TO APPLY

Please send:



1- A 60 second+ Loom video introducing yourself (failure to send a loom will mean we will NOT look at your application) and covering the following;

- Your GoHighLevel experience

- Any experience sourcing images or building websites 

- Why you'd be a great fit for this role



2- A written description of your GoHighLevel experience, specifically what you have built and how long you have been using it (send any required links)



3- Your availability and how many hours per week you can commit



Applications without a Loom video won't be considered.



This is fast paced environment and is not for someone looking to work a few hours a day 5 days a week, you have to work the odd weekend and the days can be long but the beauty is I can give you as much work as you can take on, as things ramp up expect to be earning anywhere from $2000 - $3500/month



You'll have the opportunity to take on as many projects as you can comfortably complete. 



I am after someone hungry to work and someone that has the drive to earn as much as they can, this is not for someone who doesn’t have the drive to work long hours and days!



I look forward to hearing from you!

NICE TO HAVE

- Healthcare, pharmacy, or regulated-product marketing experience



HOW TO APPLY

Send us a copy of your portfolio along with your application. We're interviewing now, the role will start part-time, with a transition to full-time in mid-August.

description:
About the Role

We are looking for a data-driven and detail-oriented E-commerce Operations Specialist to manage our daily operations across Shopee, Lazada, and TikTok Shop. This is a highly operational role where precision, agility, and a proactive mindset are essential for success. 



Key Responsibilities

1. Store & Product Operations

Manage end-to-end daily operations, including product listing creation, content optimization, price checks, and ensuring SKU accuracy across platforms. 



Maintain product listings with accurate descriptions, images, and categories to enhance search visibility and conversion. 



Monitor real-time inventory levels to prevent stockouts, overselling, and discrepancies, coordinating with the warehouse and logistics teams for replenishment. 



2. Campaign & Promotion Execution

Plan and execute promotional campaigns (e.g., Mega Sales, 11.11, 12.12, Payday Sales, Flash Sales) to drive traffic and achieve sales targets (GMV). 



Set up vouchers, bundles, cashback, and other promotional mechanics to maximize conversion and margins. 



Coordinate with platform Account Managers (AM) to negotiate policies, request visibility support, and secure subsidy packages. 



3. Performance Analysis & Reporting

Track and analyze sales data, competitor activity, and operational performance metrics (e.g., conversion rate, cancellation rate, return rate, seller rating). 



Prepare regular performance reports (weekly/monthly) and provide actionable insights to optimize pricing, product strategies, and operational efficiency. 



Monitor store health KPIs and implement improvement plans to maintain account health and compliance (e.g., late shipment rate, customer service response time). 



4. Customer Service & Logistics Coordination

Oversee order fulfilment processes, ensuring timely and accurate delivery by liaising with logistics partners and 3PL providers. 



Supervise customer service operations, ensuring timely resolution of customer inquiries, returns, refunds, and escalation cases through platform chat and
 channels. 



Address and resolve escalated issues such as misdelivered, stuck, lost, or damaged parcels. 



5. Cross-functional Collaboration

Work closely with marketing, design, and merchandising teams to align campaign execution and content with brand guidelines. 



Support ad-hoc projects and special events as assigned. 



Qualifications & Requirements

Experience: 1–3 years of hands-on experience managing e-commerce operations on Shopee, Lazada, TikTok Shop, or similar platforms (a must). 



Knowledge: Strong understanding of online campaign management, pricing strategies, platform algorithms, and advertising tools (e.g., Shopee Ads, TikTok Ads). 



Technical Skills: Proficient in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets, with strong numerical skills and experience using advanced formulas (e.g., VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables) for data analysis and reporting. 



Skills: Excellent analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills. Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. 



Language: Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. 



Teamwork: Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams (marketing, warehouse, logistics, customer service). 



What We Offer

Competitive salary (e.g., PHP 20,000–25,000+ per month depending on experience, or equivalent). 



Stable full-time role with leave benefits (up to 14 days annual leave, holiday leave, birthday leave). 



Performance-based bonuses and allowances. 



Opportunity to work with an international team and grow with a leading e-commerce brand. 



Professional development and career growth opportunities. 



If you are interested, please send your updated CV and a brief cover letter via the application link below.

title: Social Media Manager / Short-Form Content Creator for Music Artist (Long-Term)
description:
We are an independent music act looking for a long-term Social Media Manager who can create and run our short-form video content. This is an ongoing, daily role, and we want someone we can build a lasting working relationship with.



A quick note on who tends to thrive here: you would be helping build something creative, and a real appreciation for music and the arts goes a long way in this role. If you are someone with taste, who pays attention to what makes a video or a song land, who enjoys culture and follows what is moving online, you will get more out of this and so will we. We are not asking you to share our exact taste or be an expert in our style. We are looking for someone whose own love of music and creativity makes the daily work feel like something you actually enjoy rather than a chore. Strong content skills come first, and a genuine ear for this stuff is what makes a good fit a great one.



To be clear, this role IS about making content, not only scheduling it. If your experience is mostly posting and replying, this is probably not the right fit. We are looking for someone who can independently produce short-form video for TikTok and Instagram Reels, with strong hooks, clean editing, and a good sense of what performs.



What you will do:



-Create and edit short-form video (TikTok, Reels, YouTube Shorts) on a daily posting schedule

-Find and adapt trends relevant to our music and audience

-Write captions and schedule posts

-Reply to comments and engage our audience and the local scene

-Watch what performs (saves, watch-time, engagement) and adjust

-Send us a simple weekly plan to approve, then run it



How we like to work:



We want to be hands-off on the day-to-day. You propose the week's content, we approve it quickly, and you handle creating, posting, and community management from there. We will have one short check-in each week. Reliable communication matters a lot to us, so we are looking for someone who keeps us informed without needing constant direction.



What we are looking for:



-Substantial experience creating short-form social video, with a portfolio to show it

-Strong video editing skills

-Fluent written English and dependable communication

-Self-directed and organized, comfortable owning the posting rhythm

-Bonus: experience with music, entertainment, or dance content



To apply, please include:



-Links to short-form video you have personally created (TikTok or Reels preferred). This is the most important thing to us, so please lead with it.

-Tell us how you would build a content rhythm for a new music act

title: Top 1% Credit Repair Specialist (Experienced Only)
description:
Before applying, ask yourself:

- Do you have at least 3 years of hands on credit repair experience?

- Have you personally managed 100+ client files?

- Can you confidently perform a manual credit audit without relying on software?

- Do you have experience removing open late payments and using advanced credit repair strategies?



DO NOT APPLY ON THE BEHALF OF FRIENDS OR FAMILY only YOU and your qualities 

*********************************************************************************************



BTS is seeking an elite Credit Repair Specialist who produces real results, understands credit laws, and knows how to strategically analyze and improve consumer credit profiles.



This is **NOT** an entry level position.



We are not looking for someone who copies and pastes dispute letters or relies on generic software generated templates. We are looking for someone who can think critically, customize strategies, educate clients, and consistently deliver results.



If you're the type of specialist who enjoys solving complex credit files and takes pride in changing people's lives, we'd love to hear from you.



Compensation:



Compensation is negotiable based on experience, expertise, and results.



Options include:



* Hourly

* Per client

* Performance bonuses based on client success



Minimum Qualifications:



* Minimum 3 years of hands on credit repair experience

* Strong understanding of the FCRA, FDCPA, FACTA, Metro 2, and consumer reporting laws

* Experience reading and manually auditing credit reports

* Excellent written and verbal communication

* High attention to detail

* Ability to manage multiple client files while maintaining quality work



Responsibilities:



You will be responsible for:



* Completing client onboarding

* Reviewing and manually auditing every client's credit report

* Developing customized dispute strategies

* Writing personalized dispute letters (No cookie cutter templates)

* Providing detailed credit audits and recommendations

* Educating clients on improving their credit profile

* Responding to client questions through our client portal

* Tracking dispute progress

* Providing monthly client updates

* Explaining what items were removed, what remains, and the next strategy moving forward



Our goal is not only to remove negative items but also to educate clients so they achieve long term financial success.



Please explain your experience with:



* Experian Backdoor

* Removing disputes within 7 to 14 days

* Credit sweeps

* Executive bureau escalations

* Mortgage ready clients

* Complex credit files



We Are NOT Looking For Someone Who:



* Uses cookie cutter dispute letters

* Relies solely on AI or software to generate disputes

* Cannot explain why an item should or should not be disputed

* Promises unrealistic results

* Has less than three years of actual credit repair experience

* Cannot confidently explain a credit report to a client



Required Application Questions



Please answer every question thoroughly.



1. How many years of credit repair experience do you have?



2. Approximately how many clients have you personally worked with?



3. What is your overall dispute philosophy and strategy?



4. What credit repair software have you used?



5. What is the most difficult negative item you've successfully removed?



6. How do you approach removing open late payments?



7. Do you have experience using the Experian Backdoor? Please explain.



8. Can you remove disputes from a client's report within 7 to 14 days? If yes, explain your process.



9. Walk us through how you manually audit a client's credit report.



10. How do you prioritize what should be disputed first?



11. What information do you provide clients after each dispute round?



12. What are the biggest mistakes you see other credit repair companies making?



13. Have you worked for another credit repair company? If yes, which company and what was your role?



14. What are your average client results after the first 90 days?



15. Why should Budget to Success hire you over every other applicant?



16. What percentage of your clients typically see deletions or positive changes within the first 45 days?



17. How many active clients can you realistically manage at one time while maintaining quality and communication?



18. What is your average response time to client messages during business hours?



Required Video Submission:



**Applications without a Loom video will not be considered.**



Please record a **2 to 3 minute Loom video** walking us through how you would review a sample credit report as if you were speaking directly to a client.



Your video MUST include:



* Your face visible throughout the recording.

* State today's date at the beginning of the video.

* Show today's date on your screen or a handwritten note. Old or recycled videos will automatically be disqualified.

* Explain how you analyze a credit report.

* Explain which accounts you would dispute first and why.

* Explain your strategy for improving the client's overall profile.

* Explain what recommendations you would give the client outside of disputing.

* Explain what information you would include in the client's first audit.

* Share what separates your process from the average credit repair specialist.



Bonus Points



Please include any of the following:



* Sample credit audit (with all personal information removed)

* Sample dispute letter you personally wrote

* Before and after credit reports (with personal information removed)

* Client testimonials

* References from previous employers or clients



We believe credit repair is more than sending dispute letters. It requires strategy, education, communication, and integrity. If you're passionate about helping clients create lasting financial change and have the experience to prove it, we encourage you to apply.



Start immediately

title: Graphic Designer
description:
# Visual Designer (Full-Time) | Remote (Philippines)



## Big budgets shouldn't beat better local financial firms.



That's the mission behind everything we do.



We're looking for a talented Visual Designer who enjoys transforming ideas into engaging visual content. Your work will help educate, inspire, and persuade through graphics that make complex ideas simple and memorable.



Whether it's a social media graphic, an infographic, an article illustration, a presentation, or a brand asset, every design should have a purpose.



---



## About the Role



You'll work alongside our marketing team to create visuals that educate, explain, persuade, and inspire.



You'll have the opportunity to contribute ideas, influence our visual direction, and help shape how our brand is presented.



Your work will appear across social media, articles, websites, presentations, lead magnets, advertising campaigns, and other marketing initiatives.



If you enjoy solving creative challenges and turning ideas into compelling visual communication, you'll probably enjoy this role.



---



## What You'll Design



Projects may include:



* Social media graphics

* Article feature images

* Infographics

* Educational diagrams

* Website graphics

* Presentation slides

* eBooks and downloadable guides

* Digital advertisements

* Brand assets

* AI-assisted visual concepts



No two weeks are exactly the same, which keeps the work interesting.



---



## We're Looking for Someone Who...



The ideal designer:



* Has an exceptional eye for typography, layout, composition, and visual hierarchy

* Can communicate ideas visually—not just decorate a page

* Produces polished, professional work with excellent attention to detail

* Manages multiple projects and deadlines effectively

* Communicates clearly and works well independently

* Enjoys learning new tools and continually improving their craft

* Uses AI to enhance creativity and productivity—not replace thoughtful design

* Wants to make a meaningful contribution as part of a collaborative team



Experience with Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, Figma, Canva Pro, Adobe Express, or similar design tools is preferred. Experience with basic video editing is a plus.



---



## Your Creativity Matters Here



We're not looking for someone who simply waits for instructions and executes tasks.



We're looking for someone who brings creativity, curiosity, and ideas to the table.



If you see a better way to communicate a message, tell us. If you think a design could have more impact, show us. If you have an idea that helps us better serve our clients or strengthen our brand, we want to hear it.



We value people who think critically, respectfully challenge assumptions, and take ownership of their work. The best ideas can come from anyone on our team.



Our goal isn't simply to produce more graphics. It's to continually elevate the quality of our brand, create visual content that genuinely helps our clients succeed, and build marketing that stands out for all the right reasons.



If you're looking for repetitive production work where someone tells you exactly what to do every day, this probably isn't the right position.



If you're excited about becoming a creative contributor who helps shape our visual identity, contributes new ideas, and takes pride in producing exceptional work, we'd love to meet you.



---



## What Success Looks Like



Success in this role isn't measured by how many graphics you produce. It's measured by the impact those graphics have.



You'll help us:



* Increase engagement across social media

* Improve the visual quality of our articles and educational content

* Make complex ideas easier to understand

* Strengthen and evolve our brand identity

* Create marketing assets people actually want to share



---



## To Apply



Please include:



* Your portfolio (required)

* Three projects you're most proud of

* Which design software you use most often

* Your favorite designer or design style and why

* Your expected monthly salary

* The word **"Market Leader"** as the first line of your application so we know you read the entire posting.

* IMPORTANT read the line above



***How We Evaluate Candidates***

* We hire based on quality, speed, and affordability.

* We're looking for someone who can consistently produce websites that clients are proud to show off and that generate measurable business results.

* If you have both artistic talent and a strong understanding of marketing psychology, we'd love to hear from you.



***Paid Design Challenge (Required):***

Shortlisted candidates will be given a real paid project to demonstrate their skills.

title: Video Editor — Long-Form Vlog + Podcast Editing with Short-Form Clip Pulls
description:
I'm looking for a video editor to become a regular collaborator across a few related projects. The primary work is vlog-style content from a recent trip — on-the-ground footage, project documentation, and human storytelling. Think warm, grounded, and real. Not glossy, not corporate.



Secondary work will include my own personal/professional vlog content and long-form podcast episodes. Volume will vary week to week, but I'm looking for someone I can build a steady working relationship with rather than a one-off hire.



## What you'll be doing



- **Long-form vlog edits** — assembling raw footage (DJI Osmo Pocket 3, iPhone, GoPro, 360, drone) into engaging YouTube-ready vlogs with pacing, music, b-roll, and natural storytelling flow

- **Long-form podcast edits** — cleaning up audio/video podcast episodes, removing dead space, fixing flubs, light color and audio polish, intro/outro integration

- **Short-form clip pulls** — identifying the strongest 
nts from long-form content and cutting them into vertical clips for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, TikTok, and LinkedIn

- **Captions** — accurate, well-timed, properly punctuated captions with strong English grammar. This matters a lot to me. Auto-generated captions that haven't been cleaned up are not acceptable

- **Thumbnails** — basic thumbnail creation is a plus but not required



## What I'm looking for



- Strong sense of story and pacing — you can feel where a vlog should breathe and where it should move

- Excellent written English, especially for captions and on-screen text. Grammar, punctuation, and spelling all need to be right

- Comfort with vlog-style editing specifically (jump cuts, music-driven energy, b-roll layering, natural voice-driven pacing) — not wedding-style or corporate

- Experience pulling short-form clips that actually stand alone, not just chopped excerpts

- Reliable file management — we'll be working with large footage volumes

- Clear communication and reasonable turnaround times

- Bonus: experience with mission-driven, nonprofit, faith-based, or travel/documentary content



## Logistics



- Remote, ongoing

- Files shared via [your preferred method — 
, Google Drive, Dropbox, etc.]

- Hourly or per-project — open to discussion based on your preference and the scope of each piece

- Some content is faith-based. If that's not a fit for you, no problem, but please be aware up front



## To apply



Please send:

1. A short note about why this kind of work interests you

2. 2–3 examples of vlog or podcast edits you've done, ideally with at least one example of short-form clips you pulled from a longer piece

3. Your rate structure (hourly and/or per-project)

4. Typical turnaround time for a ~15-minute vlog edit and a ~60-minute podcast edit



Looking forward to seeing your work.

title: AI Data Engineer - Data Extraction
description:
Specification-Driven Extraction Engineering:



Design and maintain declarative extraction specifications—using Pydantic models, JSON schemas, or domain-specific languages—that describe exactly which fields to capture, their types, and validation rules.

Implement pipelines that translate these specifications into executable extraction plans, leveraging both classical (Scrapy, Playwright) and AI-augmented (LLM-based semantic parsing) backends.

Build reusable specification libraries for recurring data types (product prices, tariff codes, regulatory texts) to accelerate onboarding of new sources.

Design and implement autonomous data extraction agents that can make decisions about source selection, retry logic, and parsing strategies





Autonomous & Self-Healing Systems:



Deploy self-healing spiders that automatically detect website layout changes and repair themselves using Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers (e.g., Scrapy MCP Server, Playwright MCP).

Integrate semantic extraction (Scrapy-LLM, custom LLM pipelines) to eliminate selector brittleness—spiders rely on field descriptions, not fragile XPaths.

Hands-on experience building AI agents and orchestration systems.

Orchestrate complex, multi-step browsing workflows with agentic frameworks (BMAD/TEA, AutoGPT-like agents) that reason about page state, adapt to anti-bot measures, and correct their own behaviour in real time.





Platform Thinking & Reusability:



Move beyond one-off scrapers: build a component-based extraction platform where selectors, login handlers, and pagination logic are shared, versioned, and tested.

Implement monitoring, alerting, and automatic rollback for failed extraction runs.

Champion ethical crawling by design—rate limiting, robots.txt respect, and compliance with GDPR/CCPA are built into the specification layer, not retrofitted.





Collaboration & Continuous Innovation:



Partner with data scientists and domain experts to refine extraction specifications for complex, unstructured domains (e.g., legal texts, tariff classifications).

Evaluate and pilot emerging tools to push automation coverage beyond 90%.

Document and evangelise specification-driven best practices across the engineering organisation.





Qualification:



Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science

3+ years of experience in web scraping or data extraction





Required Skills:



Proficiency with Python

Experience with specification-Driven Extraction

Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, AutoGen

Hands?on use of Scrapy?LLM, Scrapy MCP Server, or similar systems that decouple field definitions from page structure

Familiarity with frameworks that give LLMs browser control (Playwright + MCP, BMAD/TEA) to handle complex, non?deterministic crawling tasks.

Classical Scraping Fundamentals

Data Validation & Storage – Ability to define validation rules within specifications and land clean data into SQL/NoSQL databases or data lake

Basic API integration and authentication flows.

HTTP, DOM, XPath, CSS.





Nice to Haves: 



Contributions to open-source scraping or AI-automation projects.

Contributions to open-source scraping or AI-automation projects.

Familiarity with data privacy engineering (GDPR, CCPA) baked into specification design.

DevOps light – Docker, CI/CD for testing extraction specifications.

* Deep familiarity with anime culture, shonen tropes, 
s, and comedic pacing.

* Experience or strong willingness to use AI generation tools, mainly DomoAI, Runway

* Exceptional attention to detail and ability to hit tight deadlines independently.

Applications missing these steps are automatically ignored:
